name: Kill Grundig Darkcloud
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
adventurer, you've done a fine job killing Grimtotem. If you dare, Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of brutes is by far the worst of the lot. He was the one who led the brutal attack on my village.

You will find him in Grimtotem Post a bit further up the path to the west. Kill him, and I will be forever grateful.
narrative.objectives: Kill Grundig Darkcloud and 6 Grimtotem Brutes, and return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.
narrative.offerRewardText: Grundig Darkcloud is dead! adventurer, I will always be grateful for what you've done here today.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you killed Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of Brutes?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 18, 2,700 XP in all.
